01 / THE OPPORTUNITY

Make it work
harder for you.

An app is useful when customers or staff need to complete an important task repeatedly. For Etah organisations, that may mean admissions and parent communication, bookings, field updates, customer orders or a simpler way to manage work that currently moves through calls, paper and chat groups.

We begin with the users, the repeated task and the information they need. The first release stays focused, works well on everyday mobile devices and includes the administration, permissions and support plan required to keep it useful after launch.

05 / GOOD TO KNOW

Before we
begin.

01What kinds of apps can you build for Etah businesses?+

We can build customer portals, booking and enquiry apps, school and staff workflows, field-service tools, dashboards and other focused applications based on a defined operational need.

02Do we need separate Android and iPhone apps?+

Not always. A responsive web app or cross-platform build may cover the audience more efficiently. We recommend an approach after reviewing device needs, offline use, notifications and budget.

03Can you improve an existing app or portal?+

Yes. We can review usability, performance, architecture and unfinished workflows before recommending a focused improvement plan.
